serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: CloudFit Federal Platform (CFP) is a CloudFit-operated cloud service offering hosted within Microsoft Azure Government. CFP provides a managed federal cloud environment for hosting customer SaaS applications and cloud workloads. The platform delivers security, governance, compliance, monitoring, identity management, operational support, platform services, and application hosting capabilities within a standardized CloudFit-managed service boundary. CFP is designed to support regulated workloads requiring alignment with federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, RMF, CMMC, and related requirements. The platform enables CloudFit to onboard, operate, monitor, and support customer applications while maintaining a consistent security and compliance posture across hosted services.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: CloudFit Federal Platform Trust Center containing FedRAMP certification package materials, assessment reports, compliance documentation, security documentation, authorization artifacts, supporting evidence, and related customer-facing trust resources.
